title: clinopodium nanum
intro: Clinopodium nanum, commonly known as Mountain Melissa, is a perennial plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to promote digestive health and relieve symptoms of anxiety and stress, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Clinopodium nanum include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects. The plant's bioactive compounds have been studied for their potential to protect against oxidative stress and modulate the immune system.
